title: potentilla canescens subvar. vinosa
intro: Potentilla canescens subvar. vinosa, commonly known as the Silvery cinquefoil, is a rare subvariety of the Potentilla canescens plant species, which belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). The Silvery cinquefoil is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions like arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla canescens subvar. vinosa include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral agent, making it potentially useful in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
